cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.
